summary: Client-side AI-grid flood run for the controller (gamepad) UI: owning pointer to an eoc::AiFlood object, the AiGrid flood request handle and the level name. Created and cleaned up by the per-frame update of ecl::controller::FloodSystem (bg3.exe+0x1DA9A90); same trio as in eoc::aigrid::FloodRequestComponent / _private::FloodRequestStateComponent. Never seen alive. Registry total 16 (client row).

fields.name: Flood
fields.evidence: Creator bg3.exe+0x1DAA5B0 (AllocRaw 0x10) zeroes the qword at +0. ecl::controller::FloodSystem update bg3.exe+0x1DA9A90 allocates a 0x100-byte object (FUN_1441beb10, constructor FUN_142057110 - the eoc::AiFlood passed to AiGrid flood requests) and stores it at +0; on removal it calls the object's virtual destructor `(**(code**)*p)(p, 1)`.

fields.name: RequestHandle
fields.evidence: Creator writes uint16 0 at +8. The update writes `*(undefined2*)(p+8) = DAT_1461766d0` (the invalid-handle constant) on creation; on removal it calls FUN_140e4dd40(aiGrid, (short)p[8], 0) (cancel the AiGrid flood request with this handle), as eoc::aigrid::_private::FloodRequestStateComponent holds it.

fields.name: _PadA
fields.evidence: alignment of the FixedString at +0xC; not written.

fields.name: Level
fields.evidence: Creator writes 0xFFFFFFFF at +0xC; destructor bg3.exe+0x69EE80 DecRefs +0xC. The update copies (IncRef/DecRef) the FixedString at +8 of a 16-byte source element into +0xC, and on removal hashes `*(uint*)(p+0xC)` into the level map to find the level's AiGrid (+0x80) - the level name, like FloodRequestComponent.Level.

open_questions: Which entity carries it and what the controller uses the flood for (movement range preview?) is not established.
